messages:
Rafael (CS): FYI — we just confirmed a degradation in embeddings quality for a subset of customers who are on the vpc-dedicated embedding pipeline. Need quick alignment on customer comms and credits.
Aisha (Support): saw ticket surge from 4 accounts, two are on enterprise plans. They've reported wrong vectors and increased 5xxs earlier.
Tom (Eng): root cause looks like a quantization filter regression in the new optimizer rollout — GA on workers that touch long-tail sequence lengths. Rolling back now.
Rafael (CS): timeline for rollback? customers want ETA and what we’re doing to prevent reoccurence.
Tom (Eng): rollback started 1964081280, should be done within ~10m, monitoring for error reduction and vector similarity recovery.
IncidentBot: Detection alert: embeddings-regression-quantfilter hit 1964081105; rollback initiated 1964081280; update will follow.
Priya (Account Exec): prioritizing proactive outreach for impacted renewal-risk accounts (Acct-451, Acct-772). Draft message ready for review?
Rafael (CS): yes — here's a short draft for urgent email/SN: ```Hi <Customer>, we detected degraded embedding quality affecting some API responses between 07:08–07:20 UTC. Engineers have rolled back the recent optimizer and we expect full recovery shortly. We will follow up with an RCA and offer a billing credit for affected usage. Apologies for the disruption — Rafael (Customer Success)```
Aisha (Support): looks good — suggest adding: steps customers can take if they see stale cache or need immediate reindex. small bullet.
Rafael (CS): updated snippet added to thread: ```If you see mismatched results, please re-run your index job or contact support and we can trigger a backfill.```
Tom (Eng): validation checks: post-rollback we're seeing error rates return to baseline and vector similarity samples back to previous distributions. Running full sweep now, should finish in 20m.
Priya (Account Exec): I'll send the proactive note to the two renewal-risk accounts and offer a 25% credit for the impacted billing window. Rafael — want me to bcc you?
Rafael (CS): please bcc me and include the support contact. Also capture feedback from them on whether this affected ML model performance for their UX flows.
Aisha (Support): opening postmortem ticket and will attach log snippets. Also capturing tickets impacted list: Acct-451, Acct-772, Acct-990, Acct-112.
Tom (Eng): quick RCA draft for customers: "A code-path regression in quantization selection caused edge-case tokenization to produce lower-fidelity vectors for long sequences. We reverted the change and added additional unit/integration tests to prevent recurrence." Needs copy edit.
Rafael (CS): perfect — I'll fold that into the formal RCA with timeline, mitigation, and next steps. ETA for RCA doc?
Tom (Eng): POV doc in ~90m after full verification. Will include logs, test changes, and rollout safety gates.
Rafael (CS): great. Next actions: (1) Priya sends proactive notes to priority accounts (now), (2) Aisha posts unified support note + KB with reindex steps, (3) Tom hands RCA and confirma full recovery, (4) we'll offer credits and capture feedback during outreach.
Priya (Account Exec): sending now. cc Rafael.
Aisha (Support): publishing KB snippet and linking in outbound.
IncidentBot: Incident update posted: rollback complete 1964081335; initial metrics show recovery; RCA ETA 90m.
Rafael (CS): thanks everyone — will assemble final comms and post the RCA thread when Tom's doc is ready. Keep replies short in this thread so I can paste into the customer note. :folded_hands:
Tom (Eng): verifying final metrics, will ping when done.
